purpose: Preview-only hybrid marker concepts; not implemented or published
common:
Use case: ui-mockup, high fidelity design concept.
Inputs: image 1 is the reference for the real GathR venue profile photos/logos and rich marker information. Image 2 is the target reference for the Current map's geographic basemap and entire app chrome.
Create ONE flat portrait mobile-screen mockup, about 1024x2048, not a device photograph or a collage. Base the composition on image 2. Keep its downtown Charlottetown streets, labels, green parks, harbor, camera framing, GathR logo, top Events/Specials filters, search/settings controls, right-side interest filter pills, location/check-in controls, and Events/Map/Specials navigation. Preserve this recognizable app UI with crisp legible typography and light basemap. Do not add new toolbars, settings panels, explanations, headings, or annotations within the app.
Replace the map's cluster-marker designs with the hybrid concept below. Retain five well-spaced clusters in the central map area, clear of the interest sidebar, top controls and bottom tabs. Use venue profile photos/logo identities from image 1: Factory, a photographic venue, Chambers, clover emblem, Merchantman monogram. Venue circles should look like 36-44 logical points on a 390-point-wide phone, not giant map pins. Use gentle restrained shadows and polished native iOS-style spacing.
Information requirements: category counts, event counts, special counts, total venue counts, new-content red dot and time status must remain distinguishable. In every marker, explicitly spell the venue total as "2 venues", "1 venue" or "4 venues", never rely on a logo or ring alone to convey the total. Event count uses a blue calendar icon, special count a green utensils icon. Keep any time-status dot separate from a venue-position ring.
Consistent illustrative fixture counts across all designs: Factory cluster = Food 1, 4 total content, calendar 3, utensils 1, 2 venues. Photographic Social cluster = Social 2, calendar 2, 2 venues. Chambers cluster = Happy Hour 1, 2 total content, utensils 2, 1 venue. Clover cluster = Trivia 1, 5 total content, calendar 4, utensils 1, 4 venues. Merchantman cluster = Happy Hour 3, 4 total content, calendar 1, utensils 3, 2 venues.
Make exact important strings and numerals readable. No invented promotional copy. The concepts are design explorations rather than screenshots of deployed functionality.

Concept: FAMILIAR STACK. Keep Current's tiny pale rounded category chips above each photo, blue/green icons and clear category count (do not use large dark navy GathR label cards). Put a 36-44-point venue photo underneath. Below each photo put a small ivory rounded summary rail with blue calendar count and green utensils count. Immediately below the rail, or neatly attached alongside it, a quiet explicit label "2 venues" / "4 venues" / "1 venue". Keep the venue label visibly associated with its own marker. Concept: SEGMENTED RING. Combine Current's light map and pale category pills with GathR's recognizable venue photos. Give each venue photo an outer segmented carousel-position ring: exactly TWO segments for a "2 venues" marker, FOUR equal arcs for "4 venues", one subtle unsegmented outline for "1 venue". Small gaps between segments; one arc cobalt blue for the displayed venue, remaining arcs pale slate. The clover marker must have 4 arcs, with the SECOND arc blue, and a small explicit "4 venues" badge directly below. The numeric total is always present. This blue ring means venue position only; add a separate small green/yellow time-status dot outside the ring and an independent tiny red new-content dot where relevant. Beneath each category/photo group keep a compact light count rail for blue calendar/event and green utensils/special counts. Give the clover marker subtle selected emphasis with a compact readable label "2 of 4" above its "4 venues" badge, without opening a large callout. Do not add a second time-status ring or category-colored ring; avoid concentric-ring clutter. Prioritize exact segment counts and readable numeric venue totals.

Concept: INLINE SUMMARY. Reorganize each marker into a compact light horizontal capsule rather than a tall stack. A crisp 36-44-point circular venue image anchors the LEFT side, protruding slightly with no clipping. To its right: a first row with a small category glyph, category name/count such as "Trivia 1" in dark navy, and an unobtrusive total-content pill when needed; a second row with blue calendar count, green utensils count and an explicit house glyph plus "4 venues". Use off-white capsule surfaces with a fine neutral outline and restrained shadow. This should borrow Current's lightness and GathR's richer information but use a distinctly horizontal, compact footprint. Keep all five capsules entirely clear of the right interest sidebar and other capsules. No segmented ring in this option, just a separate small time-status dot and optional new-content red dot. Do not turn markers into large venue-name cards or omit the explicit venue total.
